out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. CFM WAS NOT PRESENT AT THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS PROVIDED DOCUMENT.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS WILL PROVIDE DOCUMENT.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at either handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC REPLACED HAND SOAP.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: eggs stored in broken refrigerator at 48F
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. PIC DISCARDED EGGS.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: disclosure statement was missing from the menu. Asterisks were missing from combos and specials that contain kitfo.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. OBSERVED NO FFXHD PERMIT IN FACILITY.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED TWO BEER BOXES STACKED ON HANDWASHING SINK IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: BOXES REMOVED FROM SINK.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: OBSERVED UNCOVERED BUCKETS OF ONIONS IN WALK-IN COOLER ON THE FLOOR NEAR A LIVE COCKROACH. OBSERVED UNCOVERED SPICES THROUGHOUT KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. CDI: ONIONS DISPOSED OF DUE TO COCKROACH ACTIVITY. SPICES MUST BE COVERED. MOYA CAFE AND KITCHEN (Inspection Date: 01/12/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN WALK-IN COOLER COOKED COLLARD GREENS AND COOKED BEANS AT 55F (OVERNIGHT)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: TCS FOOD IN WALK-IN COOLER DISPOSED OF. DO NOT USE WALK-IN COOLER TO HOLD TCS FOOD UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED NO DATE MARKING IN FACILITY ON ANY TCS FOOD HELD OVER 24HRS.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: DID NOT OBSERVE ANY THERMOMETER IN WALK-IN COOLER AND THREE-DOOR PREP TOP
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED A LIVE COCKROACH CRAWLING ACROSS BACK OF THREE-VAT SINK. OBSERVED LIVE COCKROACH ON FLOOR OF WALK-IN COOLER. OBSERVED RODENT DROPPINGS ON A COUNTER AND ALONG PERIMETER OF FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. YOU MUST GET A LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR TO SERVICE FACILITY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. YOU MUST FOLLOW ALL OF THEIR RECOMMENDATIONS INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO SERVICE FREQUENCY AND CLEANING.

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Eliminate Harborage Conditions
violations.observation: Harborage conditions exist. OBSERVED CONSIDERABLE AMOUNT OF FOOD AND GRIME AROUND FLOOR OF FACILITY, UNDER EQUIPMENT, BEHIND EQUIPMENT, ON SHELVING, ETC. OBSERVED UNCOVERED FOOD IN WALK-IN COOLER. OBSERVED UNCOVERED FOOD/SPICES ON SHELVING. OBSERVED CONSIDERABLE AMOUNT OF UNUSED ITEMS AND LITTLE TO NO STORAGE SHELVING.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Eliminate harborage conditions to control and prevent the presence of pests on the premises. FACILITY MUST BE DEEP-CLEANED TO GET RID OF ALL FOOD RESIDUE AND DROPPINGS AND GRIME. ALL UNUSED EQUIPMENT AND ITEMS MUST BE REMOVED FROM FACILITY. THE CURRENT PRACTICES OF FACILITY FACILITATES PEST ACTIVITY.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED NO SHELVING IN WALK-IN COOLER. FOOD IS STACKED ON THE FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: OBSERVED FOIL-LIKE WRAP ON A PREP-COUNTER, BUT IT PEELS OFF AND A SIGNIFICANT AMOUNT OF FOOD, DROPPINGS ARE INSIDE OF IT.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: WALK-IN COOLER AT ~60F, HOLDING FOOD AT 55F (OVERNIGHT).
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. DO NOT USE THE WALK-IN COOLER FOR TCS FOOD UNTIL IT IS FIXED TO HOLD FOOD AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: OBSERVED COUNTERS, SHELVES, INTERIOR OF COOLERS, AND FLOOR OF WALK-IN COOLER TO HAVE RODENT DROPPINGS, FOOD RESIDUE, AND GRIME
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency

violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
